title: Beef, prepackaged or deli, luncheon meat, reduced sodium

content.title: About
content.content: Beef prepackaged deli luncheon meat is cooked or smoked beef sliced thinly and sealed in vacuum or plastic packs. The reduced‑sodium version (1018) contains about 0.5 g of salt per 100 g, allowing lower sodium intake without sacrificing flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Beef deli meat is a classic filling for sandwiches, salads, and snack platters.
Sodium reduction is achieved by using natural flavor enhancers, spices, and fermented ingredients.
Vacuum packaging extends shelf life up to 30 days without added preservatives.
The product can be served cold or gently warmed to enhance aroma.
In the US, code “1018” designates the “Reduced Sodium” category in food labeling.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Beef provides all essential amino acids, making it an excellent source of complete protein.

items.title: Low sodium content
items.content: Reduced salt helps maintain normal blood pressure and reduces kidney load.

items.title: Source of iron and zinc
items.content: These minerals support hemoglobin formation and immune function.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Beef contains vitamin B12, niacin, and riboflavin, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Low carbohydrate
items.content: Suitable for low‑carb and keto diets.

items.title: Beef allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to beef.

items.title: Nitrite content
items.content: Certain deli meats may contain small amounts of nitrites as preservatives.

items.title: Foodborne pathogens
items.content: Improper storage can lead to bacterial growth.

items.title: Fat content
items.content: Depending on the cut, the product can contain up to 15 % fat, which should be considered in diet planning.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the meat cold in sandwiches, sliced into salads, added to pasta, or lightly pan‑seared. It pairs well with mustard, fresh vegetables, and whole‑grain bread.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0–4 °C in the original package. Once opened, consume within 5–7 days. If frozen, store up to 2 months.
